senses.en: to cause something to go somewhere

ex.en: Please send the form to the office.
ex.zh: 请把表格送到办公室。

ex.en: Schools that send warnings only by app miss families who have no signal at home.
ex.zh: 只用应用发送警报的学校，会漏掉家里没有信号的家庭。

tip: send 的过去式和过去分词是 sent。

senses.en: something you do regularly

ex.en: Checking the source is a habit.
ex.zh: 核对来源是一个习惯。

ex.en: A habit of writing the bus time saves the phone call.
ex.zh: 写下公交时间的习惯能省掉那通电话。

col: get into a habit｜养成习惯
tip: habit 可数。

senses.en: about, but not exactly

ex.en: The hall holds approximately 200 people.
ex.zh: 大厅大约容纳 200 人。

ex.en: Approximately right numbers are useful, and a budget still needs the exact figure.
ex.zh: 大约正确的数字有用，预算仍然需要确切的数。

tip: approximately 比 about 正式。

senses.en: stone, or a kind of popular music

ex.en: We sat on a flat rock by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们坐在湖边一块平坦的岩石上。

ex.en: A rock concert in a small square needs a volume that still lets neighbours sleep.
ex.zh: 小广场上的摇滚音乐会需要一个仍让邻居能睡觉的音量。

tip: rock 作动词是“摇动”。

senses.en: a strong elastic material, or a tool that removes pencil marks

ex.en: The rubber is on the desk.
ex.zh: 橡皮在书桌上。

ex.en: Rubber boots by the door matter when the path is wet.
ex.zh: 小路湿的时候，门边的胶靴就有用。

tip: 英式 rubber 常指橡皮。美式 eraser 更常见。材料“橡胶”通常不可数。

senses.en: to combine different things
a combination

ex.en: Do not mix those two liquids.
ex.zh: 不要把那两种液体混在一起。

ex.en: Cities that mix housing and shops keep a street alive after the offices close.
ex.zh: 把住房和商店混在一起的城市，能让街道在办公室关门后仍然有人。

tip: mix up 是搞混。a mix of 是名词短语。

senses.en: the power used to make light and machines work

ex.en: The electricity failed during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨时停电了。

ex.en: Electricity from the school roof still needs someone who can repair it.
ex.zh: 学校屋顶发的电，仍然需要有人能修。

tip: electricity 不可数。electric 和 electrical 都已在或将在本库。

senses.en: something that is made or grown to be sold

ex.en: The label says where the product comes from.
ex.zh: 标签写明产品来自哪里。

ex.en: A cheap product that cannot be repaired becomes waste faster than a simple tool.
ex.zh: 无法修理的便宜产品，会比一件简单工具更快变成垃圾。

tip: product 是可数名词。

senses.en: a series of names or items

ex.en: Your name is not on the list.
ex.zh: 名单上没有你的名字。

ex.en: A waiting list for a clinic shows demand, but it does not treat the patient.
ex.zh: 诊所的等候名单显示需求，但并不治疗病人。

tip: list 作动词是“列出”。

senses.en: material of threads with spaces, or a network

ex.en: The ball went into the net.
ex.zh: 球进了网。

ex.en: A safety net under the gym equipment prevents one fall from becoming a serious injury.
ex.zh: 体操器械下的安全网，能避免一次跌落变成重伤。

tip: the Net 可指互联网，和 web 相近。本库已有 network。

senses.en: to come together, or to satisfy a need

ex.en: We will meet at the gate at seven.
ex.zh: 我们七点在门口见面。

ex.en: A bus timetable should meet the hour when school ends, not an office hour from another city.
ex.zh: 公交时刻应该配合放学的时间，而不是另一座城市的办公时间。

tip: meet 的过去式和过去分词是 met。初次相识用 meet；重逢也用 meet。

senses.en: a laboratory

ex.en: The lab closes at five.
ex.zh: 实验室五点关门。

ex.en: A lab rule that requires goggles only works if the goggles are there.
ex.zh: 要求戴护目镜的实验室规定，只有护目镜真的在时才有效。

tip: lab 是 laboratory 的缩写。表里这一行的音标是 knowledge，本库不用。

senses.en: as far as you are concerned, or in person

ex.en: Personally, I prefer the early bus.
ex.zh: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢早班车。

ex.en: The head teacher personally checked the lock.
ex.zh: 校长亲自检查了锁。

tip: personal 已在本库，并提醒不要和 personnel 拼混。personally 是副词。

senses.en: to remain in a place or state

ex.en: Please stay in your seat until the bell.
ex.zh: 铃响前请留在座位上。

ex.en: Young workers stay in a town only if housing and jobs appear together.
ex.zh: 只有住房和工作同时出现，年轻工人才会留在城镇。

tip: stay 作连系动词后接形容词：stay calm。

senses.en: the passage in the neck for food and air

ex.en: Her throat hurt on Monday.
ex.zh: 周一她喉咙疼。

ex.en: A sore throat is a reason to see the clinic before the match.
ex.zh: 喉咙疼是比赛前去医务室的理由。

tip: throat 可数。

senses.en: feeling pleasure

ex.en: I am happy to help with the posters.
ex.zh: 我乐意帮忙做海报。

ex.en: A happy photo of a new park hides the families who were moved to make space for it.
ex.zh: 新公园的快乐照片，藏起了为腾地方而被搬走的家庭。

tip: happy 后接 to do 或 that 从句。

senses.en: to be brave enough to do something

ex.en: She dared to ask about the fee.
ex.zh: 她敢于询问费用。

ex.en: Do not dare a classmate to do something unsafe.
ex.zh: 不要激同学去做不安全的事。

tip: How dare you 表示“你怎么敢”。本条不写冒险的做法。

senses.en: sure of yourself
certain that something is true or will happen

ex.en: Speak in a confident voice.
ex.zh: 用自信的声音说话。

ex.en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
ex.zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和练习新技能的机会时，学生会变得更自信。

col: confident about the future｜对未来有信心
tip: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

senses.en: a mark, a school year, or a level of quality
to give a mark or a level

ex.en: She got a high grade in history.
ex.zh: 她历史成绩很高。

ex.en: A single grade should not decide whether a student may join the choir.
ex.zh: 一个分数不该决定学生能否参加合唱团。

col: in the same grade｜同一年级
tip: grade 可指分数、年级或品质等级。作动词是评分。

senses.en: to throw
the actors in a play or film

ex.en: Cast the net carefully from the bank.
ex.zh: 从岸上小心地撒网。

ex.en: The cast of the school play includes students who have never stood on a stage.
ex.zh: 校园剧的演员阵容里有从未上过台的学生。

tip: cast 的过去式和过去分词仍是 cast。作名词是“演员阵容”。

senses.en: wrong or cruel use
to use wrongly, or to treat cruelly

ex.en: Drug abuse is discussed in health class without any instructions.
ex.zh: 健康课讨论药物滥用，但不提供任何做法。

ex.en: If you see abuse, tell a teacher. You do not have to handle it alone.
ex.zh: 如果你看到虐待，告诉老师。你不必独自处理。

tip: 动词 abuse 末尾常读 /z/，名词常读 /s/。本条只作词汇，不写任何伤害别人的方法。

senses.en: things that people or animals eat

ex.en: The food in the canteen was simple but hot.
ex.zh: 食堂的食物简单但是热的。

ex.en: Wasted food in school kitchens is a loss of money and of the water used to grow it.
ex.zh: 学校厨房里浪费的食物，既是金钱的损失，也是种植它所用水的损失。

tip: food 通常不可数。一种食物可以说 a food，但较少用。

senses.en: sounds arranged in a way people enjoy

ex.en: There is music practice in the hall after school.
ex.zh: 放学后大厅里有音乐排练。

ex.en: Live music in a square can bring a neighbourhood together, but only if the volume lets people talk.
ex.zh: 广场上的现场音乐能把社区聚在一起，但前提是音量仍允许人们交谈。

tip: music 不可数，不说 a music 或 musics。

senses.en: a person trained in the law who advises and speaks in court

ex.en: The lawyer explained the form in plain words.
ex.zh: 律师用平实的话解释了表格。

ex.en: A school does not need a lawyer for every rule, but it does need one clear written policy.
ex.zh: 学校不是每条规则都需要律师，但确实需要一份写清楚的制度。

tip: lawyer 可数。法律是 law，已在本库。

senses.en: a shop, or a supply kept for later
to keep something for future use

ex.en: The store on the corner sells notebooks.
ex.zh: 拐角的商店卖笔记本。

ex.en: A village store that closes forces families to travel for food they used to buy next door.
ex.zh: 村里的商店关门后，家庭不得不为过去在隔壁就能买到的食物出远门。

tip: store 作动词是“储存”。美式 store 常指商店。

senses.en: a round part that turns

ex.en: The wheel of the cart is loose.
ex.zh: 手推车的轮子松了。

ex.en: A wheelchair needs a path, not only a poster about welcome.
ex.zh: 轮椅需要一条路，而不只是一张欢迎海报。

tip: wheel 可数。wheelchair 是轮椅。

senses.en: the money spent on something

ex.en: The expense is written on the form.
ex.zh: 费用写在表格上。

ex.en: An expense that families cannot see is not a fair price.
ex.zh: 家庭看不见的费用不是公平的价格。

col: at the expense of｜以牺牲……为代价
tip: expense 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: a set of pages on the internet

ex.en: The bus times are on the school website.
ex.zh: 公交时刻在学校网站上。

ex.en: A website that hides who wrote a story makes it harder to trust the facts.
ex.zh: 隐瞒作者的网站，让人更难信任其中的事实。

tip: website 是一个词，也可写成 web site。

senses.en: a phone
to speak to someone by phone

ex.en: The telephone is by the office door.
ex.zh: 电话在办公室门边。

ex.en: A telephone number on the wall matters when the network fails.
ex.zh: 网络断了的时候，墙上的电话号码很重要。

tip: phone 已在本库，更常用。表里这一行的音标是 telegraph，本库不用。

senses.en: something you ask
to express doubt about

ex.en: May I ask a question about the homework?
ex.zh: 我可以问一个关于作业的问题吗？

ex.en: The right question about a new road is who will walk it, not only how many cars it will carry.
ex.zh: 关于一条新路，正确的问题是谁会在上面走，而不只是它能载多少车。

tip: out of the question 是“不可能”；out of question 现在很少用。

senses.en: despite the fact that

ex.en: Though the lab is small, the equipment is new.
ex.zh: 虽然实验室小，设备却是新的。

ex.en: Though a city plants trees, the streets stay hot if the trees are too young to give shade.
ex.zh: 尽管一座城市种了树，如果树还小、遮不成荫，街道依然炎热。

tip: though 可放在句首或句末；although 多放在句首，一般不放句末。

senses.en: the force of pushing, or stress

ex.en: Exam pressure is common in the last month.
ex.zh: 最后一个月考试压力很常见。

ex.en: Pressure to publish quickly can make a newsroom skip the check that would catch a false photo.
ex.zh: 赶快发表的压力，会让编辑部跳过能发现假照片的核对。

tip: pressure 通常不可数。put pressure on sb 表示向某人施压。

senses.en: if, used when there are two possibilities

ex.en: I do not know whether the museum is open.
ex.zh: 我不知道博物馆是否开着。

ex.en: Whether a town keeps its clinic depends on buses as well as on doctors.
ex.zh: 一个城镇能否保住诊所，既取决于医生，也取决于公交。

tip: whether 可接不定式：whether to go。if 一般不接不定式。介词后用 whether，不用 if。

senses.en: a very small town in the countryside

ex.en: Her grandparents live in a village.
ex.zh: 她的祖父母住在一个村子里。

ex.en: A village school with one teacher still has to cover every subject on the exam list.
ex.zh: 只有一位老师的乡村学校，仍然要覆盖考试清单上的每一科。

tip: village 比 town 小。乡村地区也可说 the village。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: The concert was fantastic.
ex.zh: 音乐会棒极了。

ex.en: A fantastic score for one class does not show what the school did for the others.
ex.zh: 一个班的极好成绩，说明不了学校为其他班做了什么。

tip: fantastic 已经程度很高，口语里很常见。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a movable barrier, or the entrance to a school or airport

ex.en: Meet me at the school gate.
ex.zh: 在校门口等我。

ex.en: A gate that locks before the last student leaves is not a safety plan.
ex.zh: 在最后一名学生离开之前就锁上的门，不是安全方案。

tip: gate 可数。机场登机口也叫 gate。

senses.en: AIDS, a serious illness

ex.en: The health class explains AIDS as an illness.
ex.zh: 健康课把艾滋病作为一种疾病来讲。

ex.en: A poster about AIDS should give facts, not fear.
ex.zh: 关于艾滋病的海报应当给事实，而不是恐惧。

tip: 书写常用大写 AIDS。本条是健康词汇，不写传播或治疗的做法。

senses.en: new information about events

ex.en: The news about the match spread quickly.
ex.zh: 关于比赛的消息很快传开了。

ex.en: Good news reporting explains what is known and what is still uncertain.
ex.zh: 好的新闻报道会说明哪些是已知的，哪些仍不确定。

col: a piece of news｜一则新闻
tip: news 不可数，不说 a news。一则新闻用 a piece of news。

senses.en: the name of a book or a person's rank

ex.en: Write a clear title for the poster.
ex.zh: 给海报写一个清楚的标题。

ex.en: The title of a report should say what was measured, not only what sounds impressive.
ex.zh: 报告的标题应该说明测量了什么，而不只是听起来动人。

tip: title 作动词是“给……加标题”。

senses.en: a raised flat surface, or a place to speak or build on

ex.en: The train leaves from platform two.
ex.zh: 火车从二号站台开出。

ex.en: A platform for student writing needs an editor, not only a website.
ex.zh: 学生写作的平台需要编辑，而不只是一个网站。

tip: 火车站台和演讲台、软件平台都可以用 platform。

senses.en: the act of leaving a vehicle, or space for it

ex.en: There is no parking at the gate.
ex.zh: 门口不能停车。

ex.en: Parking for the bus matters more than parking for one car.
ex.zh: 给公交的停车位比给一辆小汽车的更重要。

tip: 动词 park 已在本库。parking 通常不可数。

senses.en: to take the place of, or to put something back

ex.en: The new clock will replace the broken one.
ex.zh: 新钟将换掉坏的那一个。

ex.en: Screens do not replace a teacher who knows the student is lost.
ex.zh: 屏幕代替不了知道学生没跟上的老师。

tip: replace A with B 是用 B 替换 A。

senses.en: a unit of language

ex.en: I wrote the new word in my notebook.
ex.zh: 我把生词写在笔记本里。

ex.en: A single word in a headline can change how readers judge a whole event.
ex.zh: 标题里的一个词就能改变读者对整件事的判断。

tip: have a word with sb 是和某人说句话；have words with 是争吵。

senses.en: an area next to a building, or a unit of length

ex.en: The class meets in the yard.
ex.zh: 班级在院子里集合。

ex.en: A yard with no light is a poor place to wait for the last bus.
ex.zh: 没有灯的院子，是等末班车的糟糕地方。

tip: yard 作长度是码，约 0.91 米。美式 backyard 是后院。

senses.en: with little or no light
the absence of light

ex.en: The street is dark after eight.
ex.zh: 八点以后这条街很黑。

ex.en: A dark walk from the bus stop to the school gate is a safety problem, not a small inconvenience.
ex.zh: 从车站走到校门的一段黑路是安全问题，不是小不便。

tip: dark 也可作名词，前面常加 the。

senses.en: numbers that give information, or the study of them

ex.en: The statistics show who uses the late bus.
ex.zh: 统计数字显示谁在坐晚班车。

ex.en: Statistics without a source are just another opinion.
ex.zh: 没有来源的统计数字只是另一种意见。

tip: 作“统计学”时谓语常用单数。作“统计数字”时谓语用复数。

senses.en: ground, or the solid part of the earth
to come down onto the ground

ex.en: The school sits on flat land near the river.
ex.zh: 学校坐落在河边的平地上。

ex.en: Cheap land beside a river looks useful until the first flood shows why it was empty.
ex.zh: 河边的廉价土地看起来有用，直到第一次洪水说明它为什么曾经空着。

tip: land 作动词是“着陆”或“登陆”。

senses.en: the keeping of things until they are needed

ex.en: There is no storage for the extra chairs.
ex.zh: 没有地方存放多余的椅子。

ex.en: Cold storage for milk matters more than a new sign on the canteen door.
ex.zh: 牛奶的冷藏比食堂门上的新牌子更重要。

tip: storage 通常不可数。store 已在本库。

senses.en: how long something is

ex.en: Measure the length of the table first.
ex.zh: 先量桌子的长度。

ex.en: The length of a school day changes how much daylight children still have for sport.
ex.zh: 上课日的长度会改变孩子放学后还剩多少日光可以运动。

tip: 长度用 length。at length 是书面语，表示详尽地。

senses.en: pleased

ex.en: I am glad to see you back at school.
ex.zh: 看到你回学校我很高兴。

ex.en: Parents are glad when a late bus is explained, even if the delay itself cannot be avoided.
ex.zh: 即使晚点本身无法避免，只要有人解释，家长也会高兴一些。

tip: glad 作表语，一般不说 a glad person。

senses.en: highest in rank or greatest

ex.en: The supreme rule here is to lock the lab.
ex.zh: 这里的最高规定是锁好实验室。

ex.en: A supreme court decision can change what a textbook is allowed to say.
ex.zh: 最高法院的裁决可以改变课本被允许写的内容。

tip: supreme 程度已经最高，一般不再加 most。

senses.en: to know someone or something again, or to accept that something is true

ex.en: I did not recognize her in the hat.
ex.zh: 她戴着帽子，我没认出她。

ex.en: A city should recognize a flood risk before the first street is under water.
ex.zh: 城市应当在第一条街被淹之前承认洪水风险。

tip: recognize 是美式拼写。英式常作 recognise。意思相同。

senses.en: a sudden strong surprise
to surprise and upset someone

ex.en: The result was a shock.
ex.zh: 这个结果令人震惊。

ex.en: The shock of a cancelled bus is smaller if the other route is already on the sheet.
ex.zh: 如果另一条路线已经写在纸上，公交取消带来的震惊就会小一些。

tip: shock 作动词是使震惊。electric shock 是电击，本条不写如何触电。

senses.en: probable

ex.en: Rain is likely today.
ex.zh: 今天可能下雨。

senses.en: going far down, or strong

ex.en: Do not swim where the river is deep.
ex.zh: 河水深的地方不要游泳。

ex.en: Deep floods reach streets that a shallow rain never touches.
ex.zh: 深的洪水会漫到浅雨从不到达的街道。

tip: deep 可形容水、颜色、睡眠或感情。

senses.en: a play or film that is meant to be funny

ex.en: The comedy made the hall laugh.
ex.zh: 这部喜剧让礼堂里的人笑了。

ex.en: A comedy about a flood can still name who had to leave their house.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的喜剧仍然可以写出谁不得不离开自己的家。

tip: comedy 可数。喜剧演员是 comedian。

senses.en: a person who secretly collects information for a government or company
to watch secretly

ex.en: The novel has a spy, and then it returns to school.
ex.zh: 小说里有一个间谍，然后回到学校。

ex.en: A history text can name a spy without teaching a method.
ex.zh: 历史课文可以提到间谍，同时不教做法。

col: a spy for｜为……工作的间谍
tip: spy 作动词是暗中侦察。本条只作词汇，不写做法。

senses.en: at once

ex.en: Please come to the office immediately.
ex.zh: 请立刻到办公室来。

ex.en: A leaking gas pipe should be reported immediately, not after the next lesson.
ex.zh: 煤气管道泄漏应该立刻报告，而不是等下一节课之后。

tip: immediately 是副词；immediate 是形容词。

senses.en: a short piece of writing on a subject

ex.en: The essay is due on Friday.
ex.zh: 短文周五交。

ex.en: An essay about the bus should include the return time.
ex.zh: 写公交的短文应当包括返回时间。

tip: essay 可数。

senses.en: a place where adults buy drinks; British

ex.en: The bus stops near the pub.
ex.zh: 公交停在酒吧附近。

ex.en: A pub on a map is a landmark, not an invitation.
ex.zh: 地图上的酒吧是地标，不是邀请。

tip: pub 是英式。本条只作地点词汇。

senses.en: a child

ex.en: The kid by the gate is waiting for his sister.
ex.zh: 门口的小孩在等他姐姐。

ex.en: A kid walking home in the dark needs a light on the street, not only a lecture about safety.
ex.zh: 在黑暗中走回家的小孩需要街上的灯，而不只是关于安全的说教。

tip: kid 是口语。正式写作多用 child。

senses.en: hard work
an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal

ex.en: Success needs continuous effort.
ex.zh: 成功需要持续努力。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.
ex.zh: 减少家庭垃圾需要消费者、制造商和地方政府共同努力，改变日常做法。

tip: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

senses.en: to be in charge, or to succeed in doing something difficult

ex.en: She managed to catch the last bus.
ex.zh: 她设法赶上了末班车。

ex.en: Schools manage a flood better when the plan names a person, not only a building.
ex.zh: 当方案写明一个人而不只是一栋楼时，学校能更好地应对洪水。

tip: manage to do 表示做成了难事。manager 已在本库。

senses.en: a device that supplies electricity

ex.en: The battery in the clock is dead.
ex.zh: 钟里的电池没电了。

ex.en: A spare battery for the school bus radio matters on a storm day.
ex.zh: 暴风雨那天，校车无线电的备用电池很重要。

tip: battery 可数。复数 batteries。

senses.en: things for sale or transport

ex.en: The goods arrived before the shop opened.
ex.zh: 货物在商店开门前到了。

ex.en: Goods left in the rain outside a school shop are nobody's bargain.
ex.zh: 放在学校小卖部外淋雨的货物，谁买了都不划算。

tip: goods 是复数，不说 a goods。表里这一行的音标是 good，本库不用。

senses.en: a frozen sweet food

ex.en: We had ice cream after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛后我们吃了冰淇淋。

ex.en: Ice cream left in the sun is not a treat; it is a mess and a risk.
ex.zh: 放在太阳下的冰淇淋不是款待，是一片狼藉，也是风险。

col: a bowl of ice cream｜一碗冰淇淋
tip: cream 已在本库。ice cream 通常不可数。an ice cream 可指一份。

senses.en: in a short time

ex.en: The meeting will start soon.
ex.zh: 会议很快就要开始。

ex.en: A leaking roof will soon damage books if a school waits for a perfect budget.
ex.zh: 如果学校一直等一份完美的预算，漏雨的屋顶很快会损坏书籍。

tip: as soon as 引导时间从句，主句将来时，从句用一般现在时。

senses.en: to give a document to someone in authority

ex.en: Submit the form before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前提交表格。

ex.en: Students submit better work when the question is clear.
ex.zh: 问题清楚时，学生交上来的作业更好。

col: submit sth to｜把某物提交给
tip: submit 比 hand in 正式。

senses.en: a piece of a whole, or a role

ex.en: This chapter is the hardest part of the book.
ex.zh: 这一章是书里最难的部分。

ex.en: Parents are only one part of a child's education; streets, screens, and friends shape habits too.
ex.zh: 父母只是孩子教育的一部分；街道、屏幕和朋友也会塑造习惯。

tip: take part in 表示参加活动，不要漏掉 in。

senses.en: to use something carelessly
unwanted material, or careless use

ex.en: Do not waste paper on a second cover.
ex.zh: 不要为了再做一个封面浪费纸。

ex.en: Food waste from the canteen can feed a garden if someone sorts it the same day.
ex.zh: 如果有人当天分类，食堂的食物废料可以供给花园。

tip: waste 作名词是废物或浪费。food waste 里 waste 可以是名词。

senses.en: the leader of a country, club, or some universities

ex.en: The club president will speak first.
ex.zh: 社团主席将首先发言。

ex.en: A student president who only repeats teachers ideas will not represent the class.
ex.zh: 只重复老师想法的学生主席，代表不了班级。

tip: president 在不同机构里可以是总统、主席或大学校长。

senses.en: to promise to do something, or to do something wrong

ex.en: Please commit to locking the lab.
ex.zh: 请承诺锁上实验室。

ex.en: Do not commit the same error on the next form.
ex.zh: 不要在下一张表上再犯同样的错误。

tip: 名词 commitment 已在本库。本条不写伤害自己或他人的做法。

senses.en: a person's own nature or identity

ex.en: The exercise asks you to describe your self in three words.
ex.zh: 这个练习请你用三个词描述自己。

ex.en: A sense of self grows when students are trusted with real tasks, not only with tests.
ex.zh: 当学生被托付真正的任务而不只是考试时，自我意识会成长。

tip: self 常构成复合词，如 self-study。复数是 selves。

senses.en: on all sides of, or about
in the surrounding area

ex.en: We walked around the lake after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我们绕着湖走了走。

ex.en: Shops around a school gate affect what students buy between classes, from water to sweets.
ex.zh: 校门口的商店影响着学生课间买什么，从水到糖果都是。

tip: around 表示大约时与 about 接近：around 20 students。

senses.en: sleeping

ex.en: The baby was asleep on the bus.
ex.zh: 婴儿在公交上睡着了。

ex.en: A student asleep in class may need sleep, not a punishment.
ex.zh: 课上睡着的学生可能需要的是睡眠，不是惩罚。

tip: asleep 只作表语。sleep 已在本库。

senses.en: a person who reports news

ex.en: The reporter checked the name.
ex.zh: 记者核对了名字。

ex.en: A reporter who names no source is harder to trust.
ex.zh: 不写来源的记者更难信任。

tip: report 已在本库。journalist 是本批的另一词。

senses.en: a female ruler, or the wife of a king

ex.en: The queen visited the old harbour in the story.
ex.zh: 故事里女王参观了古老的港口。

ex.en: A history chapter about a queen should also say who cooked, farmed and paid the taxes.
ex.zh: 写女王的历史章节，也应当说谁在做饭、种地和纳税。

tip: queen 可以是女性君主，也可以是国王的妻子。

senses.en: what you notice with your nose
to notice a smell, or to have one

ex.en: There is a smell of paint in the hall.
ex.zh: 大厅里有油漆味。

ex.en: A bad smell from the kitchen is a reason to stop lunch, not to hide it.
ex.zh: 厨房的异味是停下午饭的理由，不是把它藏起来。

tip: smell 作动词的过去式是 smelt 或 smelled。smell 可作连系动词：smell good。

senses.en: work, especially physical work; British spelling

ex.en: Harvest labour starts before sunrise.
ex.zh: 收割的劳动在日出前就开始了。

ex.en: Child labour is illegal, and a weekend school job is not the same thing.
ex.zh: 童工是非法的，周末在学校打工不是一回事。

tip: labour 是英式拼写，labor 是美式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留，意思相同。

senses.en: kind and pleasant

ex.en: The staff were friendly to the new students.
ex.zh: 工作人员对新同学很友好。

ex.en: A friendly match still needs a referee and a way home.
ex.zh: 友谊赛仍然需要裁判和回家的办法。

tip: friendly 是形容词，不是副词。友好地用 in a friendly way。friend 已在本库。

senses.en: the science of matter and energy

ex.en: Physics is the first lesson on Tuesday.
ex.zh: 周二第一节是物理。

ex.en: A physics problem about the bus is more useful than a number with no story.
ex.zh: 一道关于公交的物理题，比一个没有情境的数字更有用。

tip: physics 作学科时谓语用单数。physical 已在本库。

senses.en: measuring a lot from side to side

ex.en: The new pavement is wide enough for two people.
ex.zh: 新的人行道宽得够两个人走。

ex.en: A wide road without a crossing is still a barrier for a child.
ex.zh: 没有过街处的宽路，对孩子仍然是障碍。

tip: wide 强调横向的宽；broad 常强调幅面或抽象的广。

senses.en: something accepted as true

ex.en: Strong belief can give people hope.
ex.zh: 坚定的信念能给人希望。

ex.en: The belief that education improves social mobility influences government spending priorities in many countries.
ex.zh: 教育能促进社会流动的这一信念影响着许多国家的政府支出重点。

col: belief in someone｜对某人的信任
a widely held belief｜普遍持有的看法
contrary to popular belief｜与普遍看法相反
tip: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

senses.en: to get ready

ex.en: Prepare the lab before the class arrives.
ex.zh: 班级到来之前把实验室准备好。

ex.en: Cities should prepare flood plans before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
ex.zh: 城市应当在雨季之前准备防汛方案，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。

tip: prepare for 后接所准备的事。prepare sth 是把某物准备好。

senses.en: to move through the air
a small flying insect

ex.en: Birds fly over the sports field.
ex.zh: 鸟飞过运动场。

ex.en: A town that wants fewer cars cannot only tell people to fly; most journeys are short.
ex.zh: 想减少汽车的城镇不能只叫人坐飞机，大多数行程都很短。

tip: fly 的过去式是 flew，过去分词是 flown。航班名词 flight 已在本库。

senses.en: what you plan to do

ex.en: Her intention is to return the book.
ex.zh: 她的打算是还书。

ex.en: A good intention still needs a written time.
ex.zh: 好意仍然需要一个写下来的时间。

tip: intention 可数。

senses.en: damaged by use, or very tired

ex.en: The coat is worn at the elbows.
ex.zh: 外套的肘部磨旧了。

ex.en: A worn step should be repaired before someone falls.
ex.zh: 磨坏的台阶应当在有人摔倒之前修好。

tip: worn 是 wear 的过去分词。wear 已在本库。表里把 worm 的读音混了进来，本库不用。

senses.en: demanding that rules are obeyed

ex.en: The rule is strict about the lab door.
ex.zh: 这条规则对实验室的门很严格。

ex.en: A strict timetable still fails if it hides the last bus.
ex.zh: 严格的课表如果藏起末班车，仍然会失败。

tip: strict 可形容人或规则。

senses.en: far from towns

ex.en: The village is remote, but the school is open.
ex.zh: 村子很偏远，但学校开着。

ex.en: A remote school still needs a bus, not only a website.
ex.zh: 偏远的学校仍然需要公交，而不只是一个网站。

tip: remote control 是遥控器。

senses.en: a room where people wait

ex.en: Please stay in the waiting room until your name is called.
ex.zh: 请在候诊室等到叫你的名字。

ex.en: A crowded waiting room shows that a clinic needs more staff, not only more chairs.
ex.zh: 拥挤的候诊室说明诊所需要更多工作人员，而不只是更多椅子。

col: in the waiting room｜在等候室
tip: waiting room 中间有空格。医院、车站都可以用。

senses.en: having a low temperature
low temperature, or a common illness

ex.en: It is cold in the classroom this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨教室里很冷。

ex.en: Cold classrooms in winter make it harder to learn, especially for children who walked a long way.
ex.zh: 冬天寒冷的教室让学习更难，尤其是走了很远路的孩子。

tip: cold 作名词是“寒冷”或“感冒”。

senses.en: very small grains of rock, as on a beach

ex.en: The path is covered with sand.
ex.zh: 小路上盖着沙。

ex.en: Sand in the playground drains rain better than bare soil.
ex.zh: 操场上的沙比光土更能排雨。

tip: sand 通常不可数。

senses.en: a path, a rail, or marks left behind

ex.en: She runs on the track after school.
ex.zh: 她放学后在跑道上跑。

ex.en: Keeping track of bus delays shows which routes fail students most often.
ex.zh: 记录公交延误，能显示哪些线路最常让学生失望。

tip: track 作动词是“跟踪”。

senses.en: in or of the north

ex.en: The northern wind made the field feel colder.
ex.zh: 北风让田野感觉更冷。

ex.en: Northern towns may need longer heating, which changes the winter school budget.
ex.zh: 北方城镇可能需要更长的供暖，这会改变冬季的学校预算。

tip: northern 是形容词。名词“北方”用 north。

senses.en: not liking change
a person who does not like change

ex.en: The plan is conservative and keeps the old bus.
ex.zh: 这个方案很保守，保留了旧公交。

ex.en: A conservative estimate of the cost is safer than a hopeful one.
ex.zh: 对费用的保守估计，比乐观的估计更安全。

tip: conservative 也可作名词“保守的人”。政治里的 Conservative 常大写。

senses.en: if not

ex.en: We will walk unless it rains.
ex.zh: 除非下雨，否则我们走路去。

ex.en: A river will not recover unless the factories upstream stop the night waste.
ex.zh: 除非上游工厂停止夜间排污，否则河不会恢复。

tip: unless 等于 if not，本身已含否定，从句里一般不再加 not。

senses.en: very valuable

ex.en: Time before the exam is precious.
ex.zh: 考前的时间很珍贵。

ex.en: A precious seat on the late bus should go to the student who cannot stand.
ex.zh: 晚班车上珍贵的座位应当给不能站着的学生。

tip: precious 可形容时间、物品或人。用在人身上时要尊重。

senses.en: to make something, or to show it
food that is grown, especially in large amounts

ex.en: The factory produces parts for buses.
ex.zh: 这家工厂生产公交零件。

ex.en: Local farms that produce food for the school can shorten the road from field to canteen.
ex.zh: 为学校生产食物的本地农场，可以缩短从田地到食堂的路。

tip: 动词重音在后。名词 produce 指农产品，重音在前。

senses.en: having a sour sharp taste, or containing acid
a chemical substance with a sour sharp quality

ex.en: The lab labels every bottle that is acid.
ex.zh: 实验室给每一瓶酸性的东西贴标签。

ex.en: Students learn the word acid and the warning sign, not a method for making it.
ex.zh: 学生学的是 acid 这个词和警告标志，不是制造它的方法。

tip: acid 作名词是酸。本条只作课堂词汇和安全提示，不写制备或使用方法。

senses.en: material burned to produce heat or power

ex.en: The bus runs on cleaner fuel this year.
ex.zh: 今年这辆公交使用更清洁的燃料。

ex.en: Cutting fuel use in old buildings can pay for itself if the windows actually close.
ex.zh: 如果窗户真的能关上，减少旧楼的燃料消耗可以收回成本。

tip: fuel 作物质名词时常不可数。作动词是加燃料或激起。
